_ghi_chu: Hướng dẫn người chơi mới (game/src/game/guide.js): lúc nào cũng biết 'giờ làm gì'. Mục tiêu hiện tại = quest bắt buộc đầu tiên chưa xong của zone (quests.json, có 'target' = node NPC_/INT_/TRIGGER_, 'tu' hoặc vật do code đặt); zone đã xong hết → zone_exits.<zone>. Dấu '!' nổi trên target, ngoài khung nhìn → mũi tên ở mép màn hình (tắt được trong menu Esc). goals.<id>: help = gợi ý khi bấm H / nút Help trong app My FPT; tu = 2 câu bong bóng của Tú khi người chơi đứng yên (lần nhắc 1, 2); phone = 2 tin nhắn điện thoại khi không có Tú đi cùng (người gửi theo settings.phone_from). {player} = tên người chơi. Mục tiêu phụ (không bắt buộc) chỉ dùng help (bấm H khi đang nhận việc, vd tìm balo cho Tú).

settings._ly_do: idle_s: không tiến triển nhiệm vụ bao lâu (giây, chỉ tính lúc đang đi lại — không tính hội thoại / mini-game / app / menu / cảnh chuyển) thì nhắc lần 1; repeat_s: lần 2 sau bao lâu nữa; max_nudges: mỗi mục tiêu nhắc tối đa bấy nhiêu lần. phone_from: zone 0–2 Ms. Huyền (vai thao), zone 3–4 Ms. Nga (vai le_tan).

help.en: Ms. Nga's message says Bus No. 2. Walk along the buses and read the big number on each windshield — press E near a sign.

tu.en: Bus No. 2... let's check the numbers on the windshields!
Look for the big amber "2" on a windshield!

phone.en: Hi {player}, it's Huyền from FPT! I'm waiting by Bus No. 2 — look for the big amber "2" on the windshield.
Huyền again: Bus No. 2 is the middle one of the three buses. Read the windshield signs to be sure!

help.en: Another new intern is waiting at the bus shelter. Walk up and press E to say hi — first days are easier together.
Ms. Huyền from FPT is waiting at the door of Bus No. 2. Walk up to her and press E to say hello.

tu.en: That lady at the bus door is wearing FPT orange — let's say hi!
Let's go talk to Ms. Huyền at the door of Bus No. 2.

phone.en: I'm right at the door of Bus No. 2 — come say hello!
{player}, I'm the one in the orange FPT shirt by the bus door. Come on over!

help.en: You've met Ms. Huyền — now walk through the open door of Bus No. 2 to board.

tu.en: Come on, let's get on the bus before it leaves!
The door's open — let's hop on Bus No. 2!

phone.en: Hop on whenever you're ready — the door of Bus No. 2 is open!
We leave at 06:45 sharp — step through the bus door to board!

help.en: Ms. Huyền is waiting by the bus. Talk to her (E) to install the My FPT app before heading to the gate.

tu.en: Ms. Huyền said she'd help us with the app — let's go find her!
There's Ms. Huyền — let's get that My FPT app set up!

phone.en: I'm just over here by the bus — come find me and we'll set up My FPT!
Don't forget the My FPT app — come see me before you head to the gate!

help.en: The bus driver is standing on the sidewalk by the bus door. A quick thank-you goes a long way — press E to talk.
The big route map on the wall shows when the shuttle buses run. Stand in front of it and press E.
Tú left his backpack on the bus! Go to the bus door and press E to look for it, then bring it back to Tú.
Find the big FPT SOFTWARE sign, stand in front of it and press E for your check-in photo.

tu.en: Look, the FPT SOFTWARE sign! Let's take a check-in photo!
Photo first! Let's stand in front of the big FPT SOFTWARE sign.

phone.en: Welcome to F-Ville! Start with a check-in photo at the big FPT SOFTWARE sign.
Don't miss the check-in photo at the FPT SOFTWARE sign!

help.en: Walk over to the Village Well and press E to draw water — three buckets, three little stories.

tu.en: There's a village well over there — let's try drawing water!
Let's go to the well — I want to try that rope!

phone.en: Have you seen the Village Well? Draw some water there — each bucket has a story.
The Village Well is close by — give it a try!

help.en: Follow the path to the Cuder Statue in the rice field, then press E to read its story and answer three questions.

tu.en: Let's go see the Cuder Statue — it's further along the path.
The Cuder Statue is in the rice field up ahead — come on!

phone.en: Stop by the Cuder Statue on your way — read its story and earn a badge!
The Cuder Statue stands in the rice field along the path. Don't skip it!

help.en: Ms. Nga is at the reception desk in the lobby. Talk to her (E) to get your employee card.

tu.en: That's the reception desk — let's get our cards from Ms. Nga!
Ms. Nga is waiting at reception — let's go say hi!

phone.en: I'm at the reception desk, right in the lobby — come and get your card!
Your employee card is ready at reception — come find me!

help.en: The Rice Grain Room is at the back of the lobby. Walk to its entrance and press E to explore it.

tu.en: What's that room at the back? The Rice Grain Room — let's look inside!
Let's explore the Rice Grain Room before we go up.

phone.en: Before you go up, take a look at the Rice Grain Room at the back of the lobby.
The Rice Grain Room tells FPT's story — it's at the back of the lobby!

help.en: You're carrying a lost wallet. Hand it to Ms. Nga at the reception desk (E).
You're on board! Find a seat — next stop, Hòa Lạc.
All set here! Follow the sidewalk to the F-Ville gate at the end of the street.

tu.en: App installed! Let's head to the F-Ville gate.
The gate is at the end of this sidewalk — let's go!

phone.en: Head along the sidewalk to the F-Ville gate — see you upstairs!
The gate is just ahead at the end of the sidewalk!

help.en: You've done everything out here! Follow the path to the office building — reception is right inside.

tu.en: We've seen everything here — let's go inside the office!
The building entrance is at the end of the path. Let's go!

phone.en: Great job! Come into the office building — reception is right inside.
The office entrance is at the end of the path — reception is waiting!

help.en: That's all for now — the card gates and the office open in the next update. Feel free to look around and hunt for golden grains!
